Under the BNS, 2023: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita consolidates these provisions. Section 336 of the BNS now replaces Sections 463, 465, 468, and 469 of the IPC. The base punishment remains two years; however, forgery committed for the purpose of cheating now attracts up to seven years under Section 336(3) itself – all under one consolidated provision. Section 337 of the BNS expands the scope of forgery of public records to include government-issued identity documents like Aadhaar cards and voter ID cards – a significant addition absent from the old IPC.
